title: Extensive Game With Imperfect Information
body_html:
Extensive Game With Imperfect Information

An extensive game with imperfect information keeps the tree, player assignments, and terminal payoffs of an extensive form, but also records what each player knows when making a move. This is represented by information sets that group decision nodes a player cannot distinguish.

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 6.3] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Imperfect information extends the extensive form model by adding information sets.
